thread:
len_sales: Zephyr POC failing on rerank: 400 dims mismatch + intermittent 413 when they send large candidate lists. Can we swarm? :eyes:
kai_eng: Can you paste the exact error and a sanitized payload?
len_sales: Paste from their ops:```
POST /v1/rerank
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"query_embedding\": [0.01,0.02,...],
  \"candidates\": [[...],[...]],
  \"model\": \"rerank-v2\"
}

Response: 400 Bad Request
{
  \"error\": \"embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 512\"
}
```
marta_ml: 512 vs 1536 means their embed model is compact. Common fixes: 1) switch to our 1536 embed model, 2) send raw text and set embed_on_server so we re-embed, or 3) train a projection (not recommended for short POC).
kai_eng: Also the 413s: they hit payload limits when sending 5k+ candidates. Recommend chunking to <=300 for rerank-v2, or use gzip/streaming.
len_sales: They want a quick curl to test server-side embed so they can unblock the demo.
kai_eng: Quick cURL to test server-side embed:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"user query","documents":["doc1","doc2"],"rerank_model":"rerank-v2","embed_on_server":true,"max_candidates":300}'
```
marta_ml: Note: server-side embed adds latency (~100-200ms per 100 candidates). For POC, recommend using rerank-small or prefilter with approximate ANN (top-K 250) then rerank.
noah_sec: Security: if they send customer data for server-side embedding we need an NDA + infosec questionnaire completed before ingesting sensitive data. I'll DM the template and SOC2 summary.
ops_bot: Feature flag "embed_on_server" enabled for org-zephyr at 2027-09-10T12:00:00Z
len_sales: Thanks — I'll ask them to try the curl, report latency, and I'll open a finance thread for POC credits. :thumbsup:
